note: This release selects the 21 SimpleTES tasks evaluated in EvoDuet. Every entry in `verbatim` and `renamed` is a byte-for-byte copy of the upstream file (sha256 of both sides); `renamed` entries live under a different name/directory. `generated` records imported adapter/configuration files; `glue` records maintained adapters, evaluation helpers, and release documentation. Task setup may download additional data not stored here.
